necessary_prerequisites.destination_heading:
操作與數學暖身¶
想知道電腦怎樣從一段文字接著寫出下一個字，不必先背完數學名詞。這份暖身先教你打開可動手的工作頁，再用動物清單、考試成績與飲料配方認識後面會用到的工具。各節可以按需回來查：程式的資料怎麼取、數字表的軸怎麼讀、機率如何計代價、可調數字怎樣改善。每次只改一個具體輸入並核對輸出，讓閱讀和實驗接在一起。
necessary_prerequisites.why_necessary: Defines local acquisition, terminal/Git/uv, activation/kernel and sequential cell operation used by the environment page.

necessary_prerequisites.destination_heading:
在自己的電腦開啟照片與語音助理¶
這份指引帶你打開第 20 章的成品：打字聊天、加入照片，或先說一句中文再送出問題。先用最簡單的文字確認程式能回答，接著加圖片，最後加語音。每次多加一種輸入，遇到問題時就容易知道卡在哪一步。
本版成品使用Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct圖文底座與Whisper-large-v3-turbo，沒有另加微調修正。打字與照片進入同一圖文模型；語音先由Whisper聽寫成文字，再交給這位聊天助理。回答顯示為文字。公開清單固定已驗證選定的配置，下載程式照清單取得配套，不要求每位讀者自己挑模型。
原理入口是20.1 的輸入分工，成品的能力及限制集中在20.13。這份操作指引先帶你走一條完整路線，不要求先重新訓練模型。
necessary_prerequisites.why_necessary: Clarifies two pretrained-model roles, dedicated environment, measured CPU waits/resources, and configuration-versus-official-model downloads.

necessary_prerequisites.destination_heading:
首批訓練資料：Git LFS 快照¶
此處發布8個分來源資料包，共29.4 MiB、1,447筆整理好的 training 紀錄；內容是已收集的教學 pilot，沒有模型訓練成果。程式與教材用普通 Git，.tar.gz 實體資料用 Git LFS，解包後放回被忽略的 data/training/。
第20章目前使用的照片、中文讀字與語音資料另有專用清單，見本頁末段。--asset all只指首批8包，不包含第20章的資料。
發布狀態（2026-10-02）：8個LFS物件已上傳，並以新的快取、不提供額外認證重新下載；逐包及解包後每個檔案的SHA-256均符合manifest。資料包由GitHub runner從固定公開來源重建，全部壓縮包與原本機快照的SHA-256完全相同；上傳紀錄。
ID	Training 紀錄	資料授權
tinystories	512個完整英文故事	CDLA-Sharing-1.0
chinese-poetry	365首古典中文詩	MIT
ultrachat-sft	100筆多輪對話	MIT
ultrafeedback-dpo	100組偏好對	MIT
pku-safe-rlhf	100組安全／有用性比較	CC-BY-NC-4.0，非商用
fashion-mnist	50張圖與分類模板	MIT
gsm8k	200題人寫解答	MIT
fsdd	20段training語音	CC-BY-SA-4.0
FSDD另保留各20段validation／test，原錄音是8 kHz，使用16 kHz入口前須明確重採樣。Fashion-MNIST包內另保留完整60,000筆來源training parquet；50筆是已配對的pilot，不是自然圖片caption／VQA。GSM8K解答不是教師模型生成的蒸餾資料。
各包保留來源、固定revision、原始授權證據與修改／選樣說明。manifest.json記錄壓縮包與每個檔案的大小、SHA-256；sources/保存來源metadata，這兩者用普通Git。資料依各自授權，不能統一當成此repo的MIT內容；非商用資料獨立成包，按需求選取。
necessary_prerequisites.why_necessary: Makes selected/all LFS acquisition and its data/training output concrete; separates first eight packages from Chapter 20.

necessary_prerequisites.destination_heading:
照片、中文讀字與語音：資料怎麼教到用途？¶
模型要學會「桌上有幾隻貓」，需要圖片、這個問題與合適答案。要學抄寫招牌，則需要看得見的字與原樣轉寫；只告訴它「這是商店」，沒有教到每個字。準備資料的第一件事，是讓每道練習對上用途，接著才談題目夠不夠多。
第20章接手已有圖文能力的Qwen3-VL，再用照片問答、中文讀字和聊天示範建立LoRA候選。LoRA是加在底座旁的少量可更新修正參數，使用時仍需要完整底座；候選要與原底座一起驗證。本版依驗證結果保留原底座，資料對上用途並不保證微調更好。聲音由現成ASR（語音辨識器）先轉成文字，真人錄音用於驗收兩站流程，不拿來更新這次圖文LoRA或重新訓練Whisper。各項資料只是有限的教學樣本，模型原本的能力仍來自上游訓練。
概念入口是20.4 的題型及20.5 的資料家族。以下說明這一版真正需要的來源、標註與取得方式。
necessary_prerequisites.why_necessary: Explains source-family/split counts, no voice LoRA training, and the separate three-package list/download/verify route.

necessary_prerequisites.destination_heading:
教材實作驗證¶
「能執行」和「能完成任務」是兩件不同的事。程式可以順利回答，卻讀錯招牌；模型也可能答對一題，只因記住題目。這頁說明本課如何檢查教材、檔案、訓練與模型能力，讓你知道每種證據回答的是哪個問題。
可以想成檢查一輛腳踏車：輪子裝得上、轉得動，還不等於騎士已能在路口正確轉彎。每一層都有自己的判尺，不用一個「全部成功」代替。
necessary_prerequisites.why_necessary: Necessary final storage distinction: file identity and runnable code are different evidence from task quality.

necessary_prerequisites.destination_heading:
教材發布¶
本課的正文是一份來源，網頁與Notebook是兩種使用方式。網頁適合順著說明讀圖與結果；Notebook讓你改一個數字、再看結果怎樣變。兩者由同一份正文產生，讀者不必在兩本內容不同的教材之間來回找。
網站以Zensical建置，發布到GitHub Pages。如果你只想學習，直接從閱讀指南選路線即可；下面的建置步驟給想修改或維護教材的人使用。
necessary_prerequisites.why_necessary: Necessary end transition: organizes paired website/Notebook access and separates ordinary reading from maintenance/build actions.

figure_review.details: No teaching SVG/image occurs in either current assigned article or the selected necessary sections. Actual new Chromium img/svg inspections are empty. No SVG rendering/viewing needed or claimed; all ten new browser PNGs were personally viewed.

own_workflow_explanation.roles: Choose browser reading, a short Notebook experiment, formal small-model training, Chapter 20 assistant use or Chapter 20 finetuning. Reading needs no downloads. The small-model toolbox is .venv; the natural assistant uses .venv-natural. The assistant has one image/text model and one Whisper recognizer: speech becomes text before chat, and displayed answers are text. Optional LoRA corrections still require the full base; the linked selected configuration uses its unchanged base. Source/manifests, training examples, model weights and private intermediate outputs have separate storage roles.
own_workflow_explanation.commands_inputs_outputs: In the project root, uv sync uses the pinned package list plus CPU/CUDA extra to prepare the environment; uv run checks basic computation or opens Jupyter. Notebook cells use shared kernel state, so altered inputs require dependent cells to rerun. The skipped-smudge clone gives source and pointers; real LFS packs arrive by selected fetch/verify steps. Initial training packs expand under data/training; Chapter 20 has a separate manifest/revision/fingerprint and data/natural-v4 with vision/ocr/voice. Release-fetch list/download/verify concerns small configuration documents before the service acquires full official models. Inference needs matching settings/weights/input tools; continued training also requires update state, steps, randomness and data progress.
own_workflow_explanation.counts_symbols_numbers: There are two environments and three mutually exclusive small-model extras. cu126/cu130 mean CUDA 12.6/13.0 compatibility; Chapter 20 separately documents Python 3.12, Torch 2.8.0 and CPU/CUDA 12.8. Initial data has eight source packs, 30,854,837 compressed bytes (~30.85 MB), for 30 formal experiments. Chapter 20 has three packs, 146,543,309 bytes (~146.54 MB); its source/family question counts differ from independent image/recording counts, and recordings validate ASR/chat instead of updating this LoRA. SHA-256 identifies full-file bytes, not good answers. I can interpret the student CPU table as one cached-model setup with two official model snapshots, separate disk/RAM/startup/chat/transcription figures, rather than universal minima.
own_workflow_explanation.skip_wait_and_checks: A browser reader skips installation, data/model fetching, training and publication. Short generated examples do not require natural packs. Assistant users skip training packs/finetuning but still need the full model resources. Wait for each setup command/preparation cell before using later cells. Start with text, then image, then speech; separate listening from answering. A file fingerprint check, basic CPU compute check, hardware/format availability and held-out task quality each support a different conclusion. The storage sharing checklist asks purpose, source/license/modifications, fixed file identity, matching input tools, split roles and measured limits.
